name: XPRS 1.12.0-beta.6
body:
Beta: test it before 1.12.0 goes to the stable channel and F-Droid.

## Status
- A post is one message, as on Twitter: the compose box counts down the characters left (130), grey, then yellow in the last 20, then red and negative past the limit, where Post is disabled. A status is never split into parts any more.
- Accented letters and emoji take more room than plain letters, because the limit is the size of one message; an attached picture takes room too.
- The compose box uses Twitter's type sizes: 20 px text and "What's happening?", a 13 px counter, a bold Post pill that fades to half while it cannot post. The reply box in a thread counts down the same way.

## Groups
- On a phone, a group is one bar that shows the path, and groups open into their folders.
- New folder is in the bar's menu (the three lines), for the group's admin, public and private groups alike.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xprs-dev/app/compare/v1.12.0-beta.5...v1.12.0-beta.6
